risks.title: Production identity and session lifecycle are unqualified
risks.mitigation: Keep production readiness false until live OIDC exchange, JWKS rotation, logout, emergency revocation, proxy trust and durable distributed sessions pass.
risks.trigger: Before onboarding any real user or tenant.
risks.fail_closed: Production operator login and API readiness remain disabled.

risks.title: Sandbox isolation is not independently proven in a live cluster
risks.mitigation: Qualify RuntimeClass, admission, node isolation, PID/cgroup, CNI/egress proxy, CSI, workload identity, scanner, quarantine and cleanup controls.
risks.fail_closed: Keep sandbox execution disabled and replicas at zero.

risks.title: Live providers, connectors and protocol peers are unqualified
risks.mitigation: Use dedicated non-production accounts to verify retention, residency, quotas, TLS/egress, pagination, billing ambiguity, rotation, revocation, conformance and semantic quality per integration.
risks.trigger: Before enabling each provider, connector or external peer.
risks.fail_closed: Adapters remain disabled unless a current reviewed policy and environment evidence exist.

risks.title: Managed backup, restore and regional fencing are unmeasured
risks.mitigation: Run isolated managed PITR, cross-account/key restore, Temporal recovery and regional failover with ledger hashes, generations, projection rebuild and measured RPO/RTO.
risks.fail_closed: Remain unavailable on any count, hash, sequence, key, fence or rebuild mismatch.

risks.title: Production SLO, capacity, soak and paging evidence is absent
risks.mitigation: Run representative topology, load, tenant skew, soak and paging drills; retain baselines and rollback thresholds without extrapolating local smoke.
risks.trigger: Before production traffic or an availability objective.
risks.fail_closed: No production SLO or capacity claim may be published.

risks.title: Protected promotion and repository rules are not live evidence
risks.mitigation: Configure the documented ruleset, required reviews/checks, environment approval and signed immutable promotion; verify admission rejection.
risks.fail_closed: Do not promote from an unprotected branch or without verified signatures, attestations and scans.

risks.title: Production memory serving, derived rebuild and erasure are incomplete
risks.mitigation: Wire the forced-RLS pgvector candidate query into serving; qualify retained-content rehydration, embeddings, KMS/blob erasure, legal hold and backup deletion.
risks.trigger: Before storing or serving customer-derived memory.
risks.fail_closed: Keep production memory retrieval disabled for customer-derived content.

risks.title: Application HTTP rate limiting is not implemented
risks.mitigation: Deploy reviewed ingress limits and tenant quotas, then test fairness, bypass resistance, retry behavior and denial-of-wallet handling.
risks.trigger: Before exposing any API endpoint to an untrusted network.
risks.fail_closed: Do not expose the API without reviewed ingress limits and tenant quota evidence.

risks.title: Environment adapters are excluded from aggregate unit coverage
risks.mitigation: Keep dedicated PostgreSQL, Temporal, protocol and deployment suites required and publish their results with each promotion.
risks.trigger: Any adapter or migration change, or before promotion.
risks.fail_closed: Promotion requires all dedicated environment-backed suites.

risks.title: Independent security, accessibility, privacy, legal and compliance assessments are absent
risks.mitigation: Commission scoped penetration, manual accessibility, privacy/legal and control-effectiveness reviews; track findings to closure.
risks.trigger: Before public, regulated-user or compliance-scoped launch.
risks.fail_closed: Readiness remains blocked and no certification claim is permitted.

risks.title: Two exact no-fix runtime vulnerability waivers are active
risks.mitigation: Re-scan every platform on any database/base change; reject expiry, a published fix, an unused waiver or any tuple mismatch.
risks.trigger: Scanner database or base digest change, published fix, or 2026-09-17 expiry.
risks.fail_closed: The supply-chain workflow fails and no image may publish.

risks.title: Framework export and replacement rehearsal is not live-proven
risks.mitigation: Rebuild identical application projections after removing Temporal history, LangGraph checkpoints, Langfuse data and pgvector/read models in a production-like rehearsal.
risks.trigger: Before adopting hosted framework state as an operated dependency or changing framework major versions.
risks.fail_closed: No portability or disaster-recovery claim may rely only on local tests.

risks.title: Protocol invocation and artifact projections lack a pure ledger rebuilder
risks.mitigation: Add a versioned interoperability reducer and populate interop_rebuilds from digest-only facts without trusting MCP/A2A framework state; preserve compatibility for existing facts.
risks.trigger: Before treating protocol projections as recoverable or enabling an external peer.
risks.fail_closed: Protocol peers remain environment-gated; no disaster-recovery or projection-rebuild claim is made for these views.
